about_short_description.short_description: Nawel provides logistics and supply chain solutions.

identifier.value: Nawel Quick - B2C Fulfillment & Ecommerce Storage Services

product.name: Nawel Quick - B2C Fulfillment & Ecommerce Storage Services
product.description: A barcode-driven fulfillment service for e-commerce that manages receiving, quality control, labeling, picking, packing, storage, last mile delivery, returns, and customer pickups.

identifier.value: Nawel Spaces – B2B/3PL Storage & Distribution Services

product.name: Nawel Spaces – B2B/3PL Storage & Distribution Services
product.description: A 3PL service offering receiving, quality control, labeling, pallet storage, order preparation, returns management, and middle mile delivery with WMS integration and detailed billing.

product.name: Nawel Hubs - Drop & Ship Service
product.description: A service allowing merchants to drop packages for shipping without storage fees if dispatched within 24 hours, including sorting, same-day delivery, and cash collection from drivers.

product.name: Storage Solutions
product.description: Various storage options including short-term, long-term, dry, ambient, chilled, deep chilled, and frozen storage designed to maintain required product atmospheres.

identifier.value: Support Services for Warehouse Automation and Process Streamlining

product.name: Support Services for Warehouse Automation and Process Streamlining
product.description: Consulting and technology services to automate warehouses and improve logistics processes, including upgrades from limited-functionality warehouse management systems.
